explication: CPython is both the reference Python interpreter and a large standard library. The main workflow starts with a user invoking the interpreter, which selects code to run, compiles it, executes it in the runtime, and produces program results. The repository also provides import machinery, concurrency, networking, and other library capabilities. The tree and excerpts support the major architectural areas, but sampled source is incomplete, so links between unsampled subsystems are intentionally limited.
